title: Handle Long Lists: - Chunk It: Break the List into Smaller Groups of 3–5
description: To handle long lists: - Chunk it: Break the list into smaller groups of 3–5 items. - Prioritize: Focus on the most important items first. - Use categories: Group similar items together to make them easier to remember. Example: When shopping, group items like fruits, dairy, and snacks into separate categories.
